collection_age_provenance: CMIS collection freshness contract: the market catalog must have been collected no more than 60 seconds before the scan freshness evaluation. This proves only CMIS retrieval recency, not provider fact time.
price_fact_age_provenance: CMIS current-price fact-time contract: the latest timestamped XDEX close corroborated against the matching X1.Ninja OHLCV close must be no older than 60 seconds at scan evaluation time.
future_skew_provenance: CMIS clock-reference contract: allow at most five seconds of positive source-clock skew relative to the scan evaluation clock.
price_tolerance_provenance: The current X1 market price must agree with the latest timestamped provider-backed close within 0.5 percent relative tolerance before price freshness can be promoted.
